_: THE LIAR (GDD 6). Identical to honest_dirt when untouched -- same material, same skin, same root rule. Strike each quadrant once: three crumble, one does not.
_why: The player's 'huh?' IS the game. One override buys a whole quadrant that refuses, and nothing about the block's surface says so.
_note: Q2 is BL (+Y is down, GDD 4.0.2). The override applies to that node AND BELOW, so the entire bottom-left quarter is eight times the work, all the way to the atom.
